def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]!=0]
    if not cells: return g
    cs=set(cells)
    mnr=min(r for r,c in cells); mxr=max(r for r,c in cells)
    mnc=min(c for r,c in cells); mxc=max(c for r,c in cells)
    sv=mnc+mxc; sh=mnr+mxr
    scorev=sum(1 for (r,c) in cells if (r,sv-c) in cs)
    scoreh=sum(1 for (r,c) in cells if (sh-r,c) in cs)
    if scorev>=scoreh:
        for (r,c) in cells:
            mc=sv-c
            if 0<=mc<C: g[r][mc]=g[r][c]
    else:
        for (r,c) in cells:
            mr=sh-r
            if 0<=mr<R: g[mr][c]=g[r][c]
    return g
